fixed_rules: Technical source of truth remains this repository.
FAH monitor uses durable CURRENT authority before stale Registry bootstrap values.
GitHub Actions are default-off to conserve usage; they may be used when the current user explicitly requests emergency deployment or explicitly requests GitHub Actions.
Runtime deployment, backup and rollback are enabled only for supported declared capabilities.
Unknown or conflicting authority fails closed and must not be auto-rebaselined.
Every meaningful ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, automation or other tool modification must update durable latest state/history/handoff before completion so later agents share the exact modification state.
Before meaningful project execution, evaluate the declared FAH execution contract; decisions other than ALLOW or EXEMPT must not proceed.
Project-local fail-closed guards remain mandatory even when the FAH central contract returns ALLOW or EXEMPT.

Every FriendY new-PPT request must first bind to canonical repository FriendY0421/slide-master; upstream byungjunjang/slide-master or generic presentation generators must not become execution authority before FAH evaluation.
For CREATE_PRESENTATION, missing valid TEMPLATE_SELECTION evidence is a blocking user-interaction state and generation must not start.
Template discovery is index-driven through template_catalog.py and must automatically include newly registered Decks and Layouts without hard-coded ids.
On ChatGPT, when at least ten registered templates exist, Stage 1 must visibly show ten real registered candidates and Free Design separately.
A Stage-1 template choice is tentative; up to six real detail examples must be shown before final confirmation and selection evidence.
Static images must never be represented as clickable template selection UI; use template_gallery_unified.py when actual clickable cards/buttons are required.
Broken Korean glyphs are an invalid preview; use verified Korean fonts or safe English sample tokens inside raster previews with Korean labels outside.

Template Selection V2 is runtime-validated end to end on HOME-PC; use the index-driven Deck+Layout catalog, 10-candidate Stage-1 shortlist when available, Stage-2 detail review, final confirmation, and fail-closed evidence path.
For FriendY new-PPT requests, the ChatGPT internal card-style gallery is the primary and canonical template-selection surface; external HTML/GUI is auxiliary fallback only.
A host-required artifact_handoff/presentation-preparation call is preparation only and never authorizes research, deck initialization, slide authoring, or PPTX generation.

The canonical ChatGPT template-selection surface is a self-contained interactive HTML artifact rendered in the current conversation and generated by template_gallery_inline_html.py from the latest GitHub main Deck+Layout indexes.
Every new PPT request rebuilds the template gallery from GitHub; template ids/counts must not be hard-coded and new/updated/removed registered templates automatically change the next gallery.

The inline gallery must provide recommendations, the complete current library, search, Deck/Layout filters, pagination for large catalogs, Free Design, card detail modal with up to six exact registered previews, and final selected-id display.
External/local browser HTML is auxiliary last fallback only; Markdown image lists and static PNGs are invalid substitutes for the approved inline interactive HTML gallery.
next_priority: Normal operation: for each FriendY new PPT request, perform host artifact preparation only if required, evaluate FAH, rebuild the self-contained interactive HTML gallery from latest GitHub main, surface it inside the current ChatGPT conversation, stop at WAIT_USER_ACTION until the user selects and returns the template id, record confirmed template evidence, and only then research/generate/QA/export PPTX.
